name: mix-ladder
description: Open-model TOTAL-rate ladder for mixed entries: stepped flow rate at FIXED ratios — locates the knee of the mixed shape, contention included. PARAMETRIC (2026-08-19): the shape block below is the default; LADDER=/RAMP=/PLATEAU= regenerate the stages at init, so exploring a different ladder needs no file edit. Any such override marks the round VARIANT (effective config lands in summary.json; baseline comparison is skipped).
_verdict: Same doctrine as ladder.json: a measurement round, not a judgment round — apiSla:false, no strict verdict line; the lenient breaker protects the shared environment while still capturing post-knee data. Read each plateau from Grafana (manifest epochMillis brackets the windows); if 429s appear, the curve is valid only up to the last clean step.
_pools: Pool demand = the pool-owning flow's INTEGRAL over the GENERATED stages x 1.2 — plannedIterations integrates whatever ladder is in effect, so prep math follows LADDER= automatically; trust the preflight numbers. Each iteration is ONE HTTP request, so top-step HTTP RPS ~= the top LADDER value.
_autoPools: preAllocatedVUs/maxVUs 'auto' = top per-second rate x 0.84 / 2.2 (SLA-p95 floor / SLA-p99 envelope, x1.2 headroom, bottleneck-flow normalized — CAPACITY-TEST-PLAN.md appendix B; coefficients live in lib/bootstrap.js AUTO_VU and are bound to the current MIX ratios + SLAs). dropped/s > 0 therefore means: latency beyond the p99 SLA envelope.

thresholds._circuitBreaker: Breaker only: wholesale business rejection aborts after delayAbortEval; no verdict line — the knee is the deliverable, not PASS/FAIL.
